theorem aimeII_2001_p3
  (x : ℕ → ℤ)
  (h₀ : x 1 = 211)
  (h₂ : x 2 = 375)
  (h₃ : x 3 = 420)
  (h₄ : x 4 = 523)
  (h₆ : ∀ n ≥ 5, x n = x (n - 1) - x (n - 2) + x (n - 3) - x (n - 4)) :
  x 531 + x 753 + x 975 = 898 := by
  have h₁ : ∀ n, x n = x (n % 4) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 => simp
      | 1 => simp [h₀]
      | 2 => simp [h₂]
      | 3 => simp [h₃]
      | 4 => simp [h₄]
      | n + 5 =>
        have h₅ : x (n + 5) = x (n + 4) - x (n + 3) + x (n + 2) - x (n + 1) := by
          apply h₆
          omega
        simp_all [h₅]
        <;> omega
  have h₂ : x 531 = x 3 := by
    rw [h₁]
    <;> norm_num
  have h₃ : x 753 = x 1 := by
    rw [h₁]
    <;> norm_num
  have h₄ : x 975 = x 3 := by
    rw [h₁]
    <;> norm_num
  rw [h₂, h₃, h₄]
  norm_num [h₀, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  <;> simp_all
  <;> norm_num
  <;> linarith

theorem aimeII_2020_p6
  (t : ℕ → ℚ)
  (h₀ : t 1 = 20)
  (h₁ : t 2 = 21)
  (h₂ : ∀ n ≥ 3, t n = (5 * t (n - 1) + 1) / (25 * t (n - 2))) :
  ↑(t 2020).den + (t 2020).num = 626 := by
  have h : ∀ n, t n = (20 * 21 ^ (n - 1) + 1) / (21 * 20 ^ (n - 1)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      norm_num [h₀, h₁, h₂]
    | succ n ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        norm_num [h₀, h₁, h₂]
      | succ n =>
        simp_all [h₂, ih, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> field_simp at *
        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
  have h₂ : t 2020 = (20 * 21 ^ 2019 + 1) / (21 * 20 ^ 2019) := by
    apply h
    norm_num
  rw [h₂]
  norm_num [Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
  <;>
  simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
  <;>
  norm_num
  <;>
  rfl

    field_simp

  have h₂₀ : x = 29 / 30 := by

    have h₂₂ : x + 1 / z = 5 := h₂
    have h₂₃ : y + 1 / x = 29 := h₃
    have h₂₄ : z + 1 / y = m := h₄

    nlinarith

    have h₂₆ : z = 1 / (x * y) := h₂₂
    field_simp [h₂₄, h₂₅, h₂₆] at h₉ ⊢
    ring_nf at h₉ ⊢
    nlinarith
  have h₂₄ : m = 11 / 2 := by

    have h₂₆ : y = 1 / (z * x) := h₂₁
    have h₂₇ : z = 1 / (x * y) := h₂₂
    field_simp [h₂₅, h₂₆, h₂₇] at h₉ ⊢
    ring_nf at h₉ ⊢
    nlinarith

        apply Finset.sum_lt_sum

  have h₄ : n ≥ 20 := by

theorem mathd_algebra_73

  have h₂ : (x - p) * (x - q) - (r - p) * (r - q) = 0 := by
    rw [h₀]
    ring
  have h₃ : (x - p) * (x - q) - (r - p) * (r - q) = (x - r) * (x - p - q + r) := by
    ring
  rw [h₃] at h₂
  have h₄ : (x - r) * (x - p - q + r) = 0 := by
    linarith
  have h₅ : x - r = 0 ∨ x - p - q + r = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero h₄
  cases h₅ with
  | inl h₅ =>
    apply h₁
    exact h₅
  | inr h₅ =>
    have h₆ : x = p + q - r := by
      linarith
    exact h₆

theorem mathd_algebra_77
  (a b : ℝ)
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0)
  (h₁ : a ≠ b)
  (h₂ : ∀ x, f x = x^2 + a * x + b)
  (h₃ : f a = 0)
  (h₄ : f b = 0) :
  a = 1 ∧ b = -2 := by
  have h₅ : a^2 + a * a + b = 0 := by
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    exact h₃
  have h₆ : b^2 + a * b + b = 0 := by
    rw [h₂] at h₄
    exact h₄
  have h₇ : a = 1 := by
    have h₇₁ : a^2 + a * a + b = 0 := h₅
    have h₇₂ : b^2 + a * b + b = 0 := h₆
    have h₇₃ : a * b + b = -a^2 - a * a := by linarith
    have h₇₄ : b^2 + a * b + b = 0 := h₆
    have h₇₅ : b^2 - a^2 - a * a = 0 := by linarith
    have h₇₆ : (b - a) * (b + a) - a^2 - a * a = 0 := by linarith
    have h₇₇ : (b - a) * (b + a) = a^2 + a * a := by linarith
    have h₇₈ : b - a = 0 ∨ b + a = 0 := by
      apply mul_eq_zero.mp
      apply mul_eq_zero.mp
      nlinarith
    cases h₇₈ with
    | inl h₇₈ =>
      have h₇₉ : b = a := by linarith
      have h₇₁₀ : a ≠ b := h₁
      contradiction
    | inr h₇₈ =>
      have h₇₉ : b = -a := by linarith
      have h₇₁₀ : a = 1 := by
        have h₇₁₁ : a^2 + a * (-a) + (-a) = 0 := by
          rw [h₇₉] at h₆
          exact h₆
        have h₇₁₂ : a^2 - a^2 - a = 0 := by linarith
        have h₇₁₃ : a = 0 := by linarith
        have h₇₁₄ : a ≠ 0 := h₀.1
        contradiction
      exact h₇₁₀
  have h₈ : b = -2 := by
    have h₈₁ : a = 1 := h₇
    have h₈₂ : 1^2 + 1 * 1 + b = 0 := by
      rw [h₈₁] at h₅
      exact h₅
    have h₈₃ : b = -2 := by linarith
    exact h₈₃
  exact ⟨h₇, h₈⟩
